prior_importants.description: The new digit keys answer whichever session sits at the cursor's index. The new sortRank moves rows exactly when a question is asked or answered, so a refresh between reading and pressing can send one session's option to a different worker, with no confirm step.
QuestionRefusedError is declared inline in a service file instead of session-lifecycle.errors.ts.

process_issues.description: Round 4 budget: spawned only review-correctness and review-guards; skipped conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability per the round budget. Also skipped review-security (the delta's only boundary change is the added isMintedId refusal, which narrows input), review-workflow-safety (no workflow change) and review-spec (no closing issues).

The prior important on the digit-key cursor stays unresolved. 91568ae pins the cursor to a session id, but only after an arrow-key press (setPinnedId is called only at use-controls.hook.ts:391). Before the operator first moves, the cursor is still the bare index 0, so the prior trigger still works: the operator reads the row-0 session, another session's question re-sorts above it, and the digit key answers that other session.
